guaikei-xiaohongshu-content-monitor 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides command-line tools for searching Xiaohongshu notes, viewing note details, fetching comments, and monitoring creator posts.
- Outputs all results in structured JSON for easy analysis or reporting.
- Requires only public links or keywords—no login or personal account needed.
- Unified error handling, detailed usage instructions, and robust parameter validation.
- Usage examples and troubleshooting guidance included for fast onboarding.
